prompt:
Our team has been following the testing pyramid model. We just ran our test suite and got: 45 unit tests, 25 integration tests, and 30 end-to-end tests. The total is 100 tests. Does this distribution follow best practices for the testing pyramid, or should we adjust our approach?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must determine the application architecture type and recommend an appropriate testing model before analyzing the distribution.
The answer must compare the current distribution of 45% unit, 25% integration, and 30% end-to-end tests against the recommended model and report the alignment status.
The answer must not claim the distribution follows best practices for the testing pyramid, as 30% end-to-end tests is a top-heavy distribution.
The answer must use the provided test case counts of 45, 25, and 30 rather than file counts or other metrics.
The answer must present findings in order with critical issues first, then important issues, and then suggestions.
